about: The Markdown and text file benchmark's corpus (scripts/parse-bench/markdown.mts). Each file is fetched from the pinned URL into .bench/markdown/files/ and never committed. kind md: a Markdown file, scored against its reading by markdown-it (scripts/parse-bench/markdown-ref.py). kind txt: a plain text file, scored against its own words in the encoding named here, and, where a twin is named, against the twin's structure (Project Gutenberg's HTML edition of the same book). derive: a file made from another corpus file by a stated byte transform (a Windows editor's encoding or line ends), the words unchanged. spec: the CommonMark and GFM spec examples, each scored against the spec's expected HTML.

spec.exercises: CommonMark 0.31.2: every core construct, 652 examples with expected HTML
GFM extension examples only: tables, task list items, strikethrough, extended autolinks, disallowed raw HTML
